evals.prompt: Find all incomplete Dinox todos tagged work that are due this week, and tell me the exact count only if it is provable.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs a bounded structured todo search, reads tasks and freshness, follows task and note scan truncation signals, and labels totals as lower bounds until the result is complete.
assertions: Uses `dino todo search` with `--sync-timeout 20000 --format json` and appropriate filters.
Does not claim an exact count while `total_count_is_lower_bound` or any truncation flag is true.

evals.prompt: Append two checklist items to note note_atlas: review metrics and send the launch brief.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the two task strings as data, targets the explicit note ID, previews the mutation, and performs the exact write while reporting revision and durability receipts.
assertions: Uses the explicit `--note-id note_atlas` rather than the default latest eligible note.
Passes free-form task text through safe file or stdin arguments and runs a bounded JSON dry-run first.
Reports `durability`, upload queue state, version, content hash, and whether content changed.

evals.prompt: Mark legacy-task-9 complete. My last search showed it belongs to note note_77, but that note may have changed since then.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes that legacy task IDs bind to a searched snapshot, refreshes search when the note may have changed, uses the returned note ID, dry-runs the status update, and avoids retrying a stale identifier blindly.
assertions: Refreshes todo search before mutating when the legacy snapshot may be stale.
Passes the search result's `note_id` through `--note-id` for disambiguation.
Runs a dry-run and only performs the exact requested status change after a matching preview.
